title: Cursed Mode — Voluntary difficulty for bonus shards
description: Optional pre-run curse toggle accessible from run start screen. 3 curses: NO MERCY (no respawns — die once = game over), THIN PIPES (gap −25%), SPEED DEMON (always 1.4× speed). Each active curse adds +50% shard yield at run end. UI: small skull toggles on omen reveal screen. Cannot toggle mid-run. This is the Hades Heat equivalent — demonstrates mastery, rewards skilled players with faster meta-progression. Keep disabled by default.
